snippet.title: Fantasy Zone: Official VHS Longplay Video [1987, Sony Home Video]
snippet.description: A digital rip of an official Sega/Sony VHS video of the arcade version of Fantasy Zone—a commercial longplay video before longplays existed. Recorded via S-video and upscaled to 720p. Features complete playthrough of the game showcasing strategies, weapons, and more. This appears to have been filmed by camera directly from the arcade screen, which is rad.
